style: Photoreal editorial sports photograph, natural and unposed, shot on a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens, soft directional light, deep charcoal shadows, gentle film grain, true-to-life textures. Colour palette: warm off-white, charcoal, muted sage and a single terracotta ember accent (#C44933). No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, watermarks or signage anywhere in the image; clothing and equipment are plain and unbranded. Any person is anonymous (face turned away, cropped or in shadow) and not a real or famous person.

images.alt: Chalked hands closing around a loaded barbell in a dim gym
images.prompt: Tight close-up of two chalked hands closing around the knurled grip of a loaded steel barbell resting on the floor, forearms veined and strong, a cloud of chalk dust caught in a single warm shaft of light from the left. Background falls into deep charcoal shadow with soft out-of-focus iron plates.

images.alt: Running shoes mid-stride on a wet path at dawn
images.prompt: Low-angle close-up of a runner's plain grey running shoes mid-stride on a wet asphalt path at dawn, one foot lifting with tiny droplets flying, the runner cropped at the knee. Soft pink-grey morning mist, muted sage trees far behind, long gentle reflections on the wet ground.

images.alt: A row of hex dumbbells on a rack in warm side light
images.prompt: A neat row of plain cast-iron hexagonal dumbbells on a low rack, receding diagonally from the foreground into soft focus, warm late-afternoon side light picking out the edges of the iron, a terracotta towel folded over the end of the rack. Quiet, empty gym, deep charcoal shadows.

images.alt: A rolled-out mat, resistance band and water bottle in a sunlit living room
images.prompt: A sage-green exercise mat rolled out on a light wooden floor of a calm, minimal living room, a terracotta resistance band and a plain steel water bottle resting on it, morning sunlight through sheer curtains casting long soft window shadows. No person in the frame.

images.alt: An empty gym floor with a squat rack and cable machine in pools of light
images.prompt: Wide view of an empty, quiet strength gym at dusk: a plain steel squat rack with a racked barbell in the foreground, a cable machine and benches behind it, each standing in its own pool of warm overhead light, the rest of the floor falling into deep charcoal. Rubber floor tiles with a subtle sheen.

images.alt: A bowl of rice, grilled paneer, chickpeas and greens on a stone counter
images.prompt: Overhead three-quarter view of a home-cooked high-protein bowl on a dark stone counter: brown rice, cubes of grilled paneer, spiced chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and fresh coriander, a steel spoon beside it and a small bowl of yoghurt. Soft window light from the top left, rich natural colours, crumbs and texture, no packaging.
